title: Terms of the Net Energy Metering Agreement — Termination at the Customer's Request While Service Continues
content:
**Scope.** Under Net Energy Metering, this rule governs the customer's own decision to end an operating net metering agreement while keeping electric service at the address, under a rider whose termination disposition is cash out. An agreement under a rider whose termination disposition is forfeit is outside this rule; its bank is forfeited at termination as the base rule provides.

**When the settlement is fixed.** The requested-termination settlement is not fixed until the bank carries the anniversary cash-out owed for every true-up bill issued since permission to operate. While the bank lacks the anniversary cash-out owed for any such true-up bill, the requested-termination settlement is not fixed.

**Settlement.** When the customer ends the agreement while keeping electric service at the address, under a rider whose termination disposition is cash out, the requested-termination payout is paid by check and the rest of the bank is surrendered, so the bank stands at zero once the agreement is terminated. This rule settles a requested-termination payout of at least the rider's check minimum; a smaller one is credited to the service agreement as the base rule provides.

## Coverage at a glance

| Situation | Under this rule |
|---|---|
| Customer ends an operating agreement, keeps electric service at the address, rider's termination disposition is cash out | Yes |
| Rider whose termination disposition is forfeit | No; the bank is forfeited at termination |
| Requested-termination payout below the rider's check minimum | No; credited to the service agreement |

## Ending the agreement — `end_net_metering_on_request_fe4f3e33`

**Capability.** The customer ends their operating net metering agreement: the agreement becomes terminated as of the day the tool is run, the termination payout is recorded as a termination settlement paid by check, any part of the bank not paid is recorded as surrendered at termination, and the agreement's banked credit becomes 0.00. The electric service itself is not changed. Afterwards the agreement shows terminated status and the history shows the check payout, and the surrendered amount when it is above zero.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool. The representative unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `nem_agreement_id` | Reference number of the customer's net metering agreement, as given to the customer by the representative from the agreement lookup | Identifier |
| `payout_usd` | Termination payout to be sent by check, exactly as the representative states it | USD, positive decimal with 2 decimal places |
| `surrendered_usd` | Part of the bank that is not paid and is surrendered, exactly as the representative states it | USD, decimal with 2 decimal places; 0.00 when nothing is surrendered |

**Return.** On success the receipt carries `status` "terminated"; `nem_agreement_id`; `termination_date`, the day's date in YYYY-MM-DD; `payout_reference`, the reference number of the check payout entry; `payout_amount` and `surrendered_amount` in USD with 2 decimals; and `credit_bank_balance`, 0.00 after settlement.
